intent: Small original postal apprentice mascot and bottom-HUD-style glossy piggy-bank replacement

prompts.pig:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a single production transparent-background mobile-game HUD icon for Magic Mail, replacing a box-shaped bank safe with a PIGGY BANK. The existing bottom HUD uses shiny turquoise folded-map icon, bright gold cup with purple star, rounded cyan-and-pink people, and purple/gold book: match that chunky, very glossy, saturated casual-puzzle-game enamel art language exactly.
ONE squat adorable piggy bank in purple glossy enamel, rosy coral pink round snout with two clear nostrils, big friendly readable eyes, two small triangular ears with coral interiors, four little rounded golden feet, tiny curly tail. Face oriented toward viewer and slightly toward LEFT, compact three-quarter view; face and snout clearly visible. Rounded plump body, short legs, recognizable pig silhouette first. Broad white polished highlights on forehead and body; deep violet colored shadow on underside; golden rim on coin slot at top of back, ONE shiny gold coin partly inserted into that slot. Tiny golden envelope clasp on a simple turquoise collar gives our postal identity. Chunky and friendly, no excessive details. The pig itself is the icon, NOT a pig drawn on a circular badge, no medallion backdrop, no safe box, no treasure chest, no mailbag, no extra props surrounding it.
Clean 2D illustrated mobile game icon with graphic gradients, not realistic or photographic; glossy like candy-coated enamel but definitely an original postal piggy bank. Strong readability at 64 px. Center whole pig and single coin, 9% transparent margin all sides, square canvas. Genuinely transparent alpha outside the object; NO scene, no ground plane, no shadow outside, no text, no label, no watermark.
prompts.character:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original small cheerful female postal apprentice mascot for Magic Mail mobile puzzle game, full-body front-facing production 2D cutout on genuine transparent background. She is a NEW ORIGINAL character, not an existing Candy Crush character. Casual mobile-game cartoon proportions: very big round expressive head and tiny compact body, about 2.5 heads tall total, short legs, oversized little boots and mitt-like hands, simple recognizable silhouette at small scale. Warm friendly medium-light peach skin, big lively emerald eyes, small round nose, wide delighted smile with clear clean mouth, chestnut brown bob haircut with two lively short side tufts. Oversized jaunty TURQUOISE postal cap with a chunky golden envelope badge and purple brim. Short royal-violet bell-shaped postal coat with cream cuffs and two big gold buttons, coral-red scarf, dark plum leggings, chunky brown-purple boots with gold buckles. A small cream-gold envelope-shaped delivery satchel hangs at one hip on a simple brown strap. Her right hand waves toward player, other hand holds a single cream letter with a glossy plum wax seal. Both arms clearly visible with space from torso, both legs correct and separate, boots rest on same flat horizontal baseline, whole body faces FRONT with minimal twist, readable confident cheerful stance. No scenery or cast shadow, no podium, no wooden cutout support. No crown, no princess gown, no candy costume, no golden pigtails.
Art direction: polished original 2D glossy casual puzzle-game illustration matching Magic Mail's orange-haired male courier red coat/teal scarf and the cream owl's purple cape/teal bow; she belongs in that world but with a shorter rounder silhouette and her own costume. Broad drawn white specular patches on cap, buttons, satchel and boots; clean bold colored outlines, simple large colored shadow shapes, bright saturated turquoise/plum/coral/gold palette, little microdetail, rich clean finish. Entire character fully inside portrait-ish canvas with generous transparent padding. Simple cartoon acting, no realistic skin, no realistic fabric, no photorealistic or 3D render. NO lettering, no name, no labels, no watermark. ONE character only.
